items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He chose Flanagan and Arthur Taylor for members to finish the session.

ctx.x: I thought that was Tommy and …

It was Tommy Flanagan, but before Tommy and them did it uh, I did it with a drummer named Lex Humphries and Paul Chambers and Trane. And then uh, we uh, reflectively, I was with J. J. Johnson. I went out of town and Lex Humphries was with Dizzy Gillespie. He went out of town. So when we returned to town, uh, Coltrane had to, had to finish … the company said, "No, you gotta do this recording." So he chose some other people. He chose Flanagan and Arthur Taylor for members to finish the session.
So you would have been on the session?
